Text:
## Inpatient

## INITIAL TREATMENT WITH CEFEPIME AND VANCOMYCIN
## FOR PERITONITIS ASSOCIATED WITH PERITONEAL DIALYSIS
Cefepime 1 gm PD and vancomycin 30 mg/kg PD loading dose in 2000 mL
2.5% dextrose diaslyate solution. Order follow up dose from main outpt menu.
[Click Here] to order WITH heparin
If Heparin is contraindicated then:
[Click Here] to order WITHOUT heparin ## Outpatient

## VANCOMYCIN
## FOR PERITONITIS ASSOCIATED WITH PERITONEAL DIALYSIS
## Choose loading dose based on patient's adjusted body weight (AJBW)
## (see below for AJBW calculation)
## AJBW < 50 kg:
Vancomycin 1000 mg PD loading dose, pharmacy to redose in in 3-7 days
## AJBW >/= 50 kg and <85 kg:
Vancomycin 2000 mg PD loading dose, pharmacy to redose in in 3-7 days
## AJBW >/= 85 kg:
Vancomycin 3000 mg PD loading dose, pharmacy to redose in in 3-7 days
## Pharmacy may be contacted at pager number 612-818-0841 for dosing information.
Calculations:
AJBW = Ideal Body Weight (IBW) + 0.4 (Actual Body Weight - IBW)
IBW:
Males: IBW = 50 kg + 2.3 kg for each inch over 5 feet
Females: IBW = 45.5 kg + 2.3 kg for each inch over 5 feet
Inpt: ORZID3 GMENU PD INIT CEFEPIME 1GM Q24H VANCO 15-30MG/KG Q5-7D
